events.name: Claude Solvathon
events.description: Claude Solvathon is a premier three-stage AI challenge designed to simulate real-world AI problem-solving under pressure. Hosted at Tantra Fiesta, the competition tests teamwork, creativity, and technical proficiency across messy data wrangling and an open-ended problem-solving final challenge.

events.name: Analytica
events.description: Analytica is IIIT Nagpur's flagship Machine Learning and Data Science hackathon. The first round will be hosted online on Unstop, and the final offline round will be conducted at IIIT Nagpur. Designed to ignite creativity, problem-solving, and technical rigor, Analytica challenges participants to apply ML/DS skills to solve real-world problems in a limited time.

events.name: Genathon
events.description: Genathon 3.0 is a hackathon that invites students to create solutions for real-world problems. The event begins with an online quiz to test technical knowledge, followed by a 24-hour offline hackathon. The focus is on creative ideation, rapid prototyping, and collaboration to build impactful tech solutions.

events.name: Bug Bounty Blitz
events.description: A creative workshop on blending tech with art.

events.name: Trail Tracer
events.description: Trail Tracer 2.0 challenges participants to build autonomous robots that trace a black path on a white surface. The event tests real-time control, algorithms, and problem-solving in increasingly complex tracks, fostering robotics, coding, and teamwork skills while driving innovation and practical learning in embedded systems and IoT.

events.name: Micromouse
events.description: Micromouse Challenge is a robotics event where participants design small autonomous robots capable of solving a maze. Starting from a corner cell, the robots must navigate efficiently to the center. The event tests maze-solving algorithms, decision-making, and control accuracy, encouraging innovation, teamwork, and real-world application of robotics and AI.

events.name: Robowars
events.description: Robowars is a high-adrenaline combat robotics event where participants design and build manually controlled combat robots to battle in an enclosed arena. Hosted by IIIT Nagpur, the event tests mechanical strength, weapon systems, durability, and strategy.

events.name: Algorithmia
events.description: Algorithmia is a prestigious ICPC-style coding competition by DotSlash, Coding Club of IIIT Nagpur. Teams will battle to solve challenging algorithmic problems, testing their teamwork, creativity, and coding speed at a national level during TantraFiesta.

events.name: Codefiesta
events.description: CodeFiesta is the flagship online individual coding contest of DotSlash, IIIT Nagpur. This national-level event challenges participants with 5-6 algorithmic problems in a 2-hour Codeforces contest, testing speed, accuracy, and problem-solving skills.

events.name: Quant Quest
events.description: Quant Quest is a premier competition in algorithmic trading where participants design and execute high-performing trading strategies. Hosted by IIIT Nagpur, the event allows participants to explore the world of quantitative trading using advanced AI tools or by manually coding their strategies.

events.name: Winter Game Jam
events.description: Game Jam is a game development marathon where participants unleash creativity by designing unique games inspired by Tantrafiesta's theme. The event promotes innovation, storytelling, and fun gameplay while challenging participants to align creativity with technology.

events.name: Render Riot
events.description: Render Riot is a 3D animation competition hosted by Dimensions Club at IIIT Nagpur as part of TantraFiesta. It provides a platform for students to showcase creativity, storytelling, and technical skills in 3D modeling and animation.

events.name: Design-a-thon
events.description: Design-A-thon is a UI/UX event that challenges participants to create innovative solutions to real-world problems. The event is a design hackathon organized by Strokes, the official design club of IIIT Nagpur. We aim to test participant's creativity, problem-solving skills, and design methodologies in a competitive environment.

events.name: BrandXperience
events.description: BrandXperience is Tantra Fiesta's flagship marketing and branding competition, designed to unleash creativity in advertising, storytelling, and brand positioning. It challenges participants to build innovative campaigns that blend strategy and imagination, testing their ability to influence, inspire, and connect with real-world audiences under pressure.

events.name: Women's Only Hackathon
events.description: WomenInDev 2.0 is a women-only hackathon empowering female developers to create innovative technology-driven solutions to real-world problems. This event promotes diversity and collaboration, offering participants a platform to demonstrate skills in web development, app development, AI/ML, and more, fostering creativity and problem-solving through a competitive yet inclusive environment.

events.name: Enigma Xplore 3.0
events.description: EnigmaXplore is a cyber security competition- Jeopardy Style, for participants to show their skills in various areas of computing and solve real-life security challenges. It's an online live time event, having challenges from different categories like Reverse Engineering, Binary Exploitation, Forensics, Web Exploitation, cryptography etc.

events.name: Circuit Design
events.description: The Circuit Design Competition is a thrilling showcase of electrical engineering prowess and innovation. Participants are tasked with creating electronic circuits to address a specific challenge. They must work within defined rules and constraints, utilizing a diverse array of components. Creativity, efficiency, and practicality are highly prized, and expert judges evaluate the designs based on various criteria.

events.name: VLSI
events.description: Dark Silicon (or Silicon Umbra) is a national-level VLSI design challenge where participants solve real-world problems using digital logic design, simulation, and FPGA prototyping. The event bridges academic theory and industry-grade practice while exposing students to semiconductor challenges, EDA tools, and real hardware implementation.

events.name: Atal Tinkering
events.description: The Atal Tinkering Lab Competition encourages young innovators to ideate, prototype, and present solutions for real-world challenges. Through offline and online rounds, participants showcase creativity, problem-solving, and impact, aiming to build a smarter, sustainable future driven by innovation, design thinking, and technology.

events.name: Bioinformatics
events.description: Code of Gene-iuses is an exciting, interdisciplinary hackathon open to students of all years. The event combines the worlds of biology, coding, and machine learning in a unique attack-and-defense competition format. Participants will face rapid quizzes, hands-on bioinformatics challenges, and machine learning problem statements that push them to think creatively under time pressure.

events.name: Fintech
events.description: Finix is a FinTech hackathon that fuses finance with artificial intelligence to spark the future of innovation. It challenges participants to apply AI-driven approaches, encouraging creative and practical thinking to build meaningful solutions in the financial ecosystem.

events.name: Quantum
events.description: The Quantum Computing Hackathon is a national-level competition designed to spark innovation in quantum technologies. It is more than a competition, it's a guided journey into the world of quantum problem-solving. Designed for all levels, it ensures every participant learns the foundations, applies concepts, and builds prototypes that reimagine classical problems through the lens of quantum computing.

events.name: Web 3
events.description: The Blockchain Hackathon at Tantrafiesta aims to ignite a culture of decentralized innovation. Participants will dive into the EVM ecosystem, experiment with smart contracts, and build prototypes that tackle real-world challenges in DeFi, RWA, DeFAI, interoperability, and beyond. This is not just about coding—it’s about reimagining how trust, transparency, and collaboration work in the digital age.

events.name: CodeDualz
events.description: CodeDualz is a Head-to-Head Competitive Programming Battle where teams battle through multiple knockout rounds, crowning a DSA winner team in Central Asia's largest technical fest TantraFiesta’25, at IIIT Nagpur. The event combines the thrill of DSA problem-solving with the intensity of direct face to face duels with top coding teams from all over the nation.

events.name: Valorant
events.description: Pheonix Cup is a 5v5 team-based tactical first-person shooter tournament. Teams will compete in a high-skill game that combines classic gunplay with unique hero abilities. Attackers plant the spike, defenders stop them. The first to 13 rounds wins.

events.name: BGMI
events.description: Combat Carnage is a Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) tournament where up to 100 players compete in a large map survival with looting, shooting, vehicles, and strategic gameplay. The last team/player standing wins.

events.name: FreeFire
events.description: Firestorm Rampage is a fast-paced battle royale tournament on Garena Free Fire. Up to 50 players drop onto an island to collect weapons and resources, fighting to be the last player or team that survives. The event is known for its quick matches and strategic use of character abilities.

events.name: Call of Duty
events.description: Critical Ops is a First-Person Shooter tournament that features classic fast-paced COD gunplay, with customizable loadouts, perks, and high-action matches. It is popular in both casual and competitive scenes, known for intense team fights.

events.name: Clash of Clans
events.description: A creative workshop on blending tech with art.

events.name: Clash Royale
events.description: A creative workshop on blending tech with art.

events.name: Chess
events.description: Knights Legacy is a 1v1 chess tournament. The objective is to checkmate the opponent's king. Online chess has grown massively, and this event features both online prelims and an offline final round.
